Hudson Stone & Brooklyn Pitts react to the iconic "Shuffle of Love"! 💕|  Clip Crawl | Disney Channel
Watch this episode of Clip Crawl with Brooklynn Pitts and Hudson Stone from Camp Rock 3, where they revisit iconic clips, fan favorite moments and throwbacks from Camp Rock, Descendants, and more!

Disney stars revisit the most iconic clips, viral moments, and fan-favorite videos, and share reactions, memories and takes along the way. 

Camp Rock 3 is available on Disney Channel August 13 and Disney+ next day.
